attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file TN franchise and excise tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in TN (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq apportionment.state_code "TN" eq and

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets TN economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.state_code "TN" eq and

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - filing required for both taxes
action_details.action_postfix: "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to physical presence in Tennessee. Both taxes apply: 1. Franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth (greater of book value or property) 2. Excise tax: 6.5% on net earnings (apportioned income). Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007 (Excise tax), TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax), Form FAE 170 (Franchise and Excise Tax Return), TN Revenue Ruling 07-24 (Physical presence nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in TN. Economic nexus applies to both franchise and excise taxes. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), TN Code § 67-4-2007(b) (Economic nexus), TN Notice 20-11 (Marketplace Facilitator Act and Economic Nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_excise_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_total_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No TN nexus - no filing requirement for franchise or excise tax. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Income Adjustments Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate TN state additions and subtractions
No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth. Net worth is the greater of book value or property value in TN.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Franchise Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe franchise tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive net worth in TN

action_details.action_comment: Calculate franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth
action_details.action_postfix:
result.tn_net_worth result.tn_franchise_tax_rate mul /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef
"TN franchise tax calculation: 1. Determine net worth: Greater of: Book value (capital stock + surplus + undivided profits) or Fair market value of property owned/used in TN. 2. Apply franchise tax rate: Net worth × 0.25%. 3. Combined minimum tax (franchise + excise): $100. The franchise tax is separate from and in addition to the excise tax. Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax rate), TN Code § 67-4-2111 (Determination of net worth), Form FAE 170 Schedule F (Franchise Tax Calculation), TN Revenue Ruling 17-01 (Net worth valuation methods)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No net worth - franchise tax is zero
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef
"No net worth in TN - no franchise tax liability. Excise tax may still apply if there is net earnings." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef
"No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN excise tax: 6.5% on apportioned net earnings. Combines with franchise tax for total TN tax liability.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Excise Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe excise tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate excise tax: 6.5% on apportioned income
action_details.action_postfix:
apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate mul /result.tn_excise_tax xdef
result.tn_excise_tax apportionment.state_credits sub 0.0 max /result.tn_excise_tax xdef
result.tn_franchise_tax result.tn_excise_tax add /result.tn_total_tax xdef
result.tn_minimum_tax result.tn_total_tax max /result.tn_total_tax xdef
result.tn_total_tax /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"TN franchise and excise tax calculation: EXCISE TAX (6.5% on net earnings): 1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. TN additions: + [Table 51920] 3. TN subtractions: - [Table 51920] 4. TN taxable income before apportionment: = [Subtotal] 5. Apportioned to TN: × [Single-sales factor %] 6. TN taxable income: = [Result] 7. Excise tax rate: × 6.5% 8. Excise tax before credits: = [Tax] 9. TN credits: - [Credits] 10. TN excise tax: = [Final excise tax]. FRANCHISE TAX (0.25% on net worth): 11. TN net worth: [From table 51960] 12. Franchise tax rate: × 0.25% 13. TN franchise tax: = [Franchise tax]. TOTAL TAX: 14. Combined tax: Excise tax + Franchise tax 15. Minimum tax: $100 16. TN total tax: = Greater of combined or minimum. Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007 (Excise tax rate: 6.5%), TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax rate: 0.25%), TN Code § 67-4-2006 (Net earnings definition), Form FAE 170 (Franchise and Excise Tax Return), TN Revenue Ruling 10-22 (Single-sales apportionment)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No net earnings - excise tax is zero
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.tn_excise_tax xdef
result.tn_franchise_tax /result.tn_total_tax xdef
result.tn_franchise_tax 0 gt { result.tn_minimum_tax result.tn_total_tax max /result.tn_total_tax xdef } if
result.tn_total_tax /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No TN net earnings - no excise tax liability. Franchise tax still applies if there is net worth. Minimum tax ($100) applies if franchise tax is owed." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.tn_excise_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_total_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No TN nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
